verdict_reason: REQ-ADDR-017/018 are restored correctly, but the rewritten SCN-ADDR-014-E claims check your answers offers per-role Edit details, which the code and REQ-CYA-026 deny.

todos.issue: SCN-ADDR-014-E's WHEN was rewritten from 'views the contact address on the review' to 'views that role on the consignment addresses page or the check-your-answers view', and its THEN says the user can choose a different address and edit this address's details as two separate actions. That is not true on check your answers. At animals-frontend ed23c57, consignment-addresses.js:60-64 calls partyRow with only errorText and no edit, so a party row has no action, and party-row.js:38-50 adds 'Edit details' only when an edit is passed. The card offers one heading Change link. REQ-CYA-026 in this same PR says 'no party row carries a link'. The two specs now contradict each other, and the scenario claims behaviour the review does not have.
todos.fix: Must: SCN-ADDR-014-E names only the places where a role's copied address offers both choosing another address and editing its details, which is the consignment addresses page. One way: change the WHEN to 'the user views that role on the consignment addresses page'.
